name: multiple-business
description: Run POS and ecommerce frontend + backend from one folder

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix node-learning" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5001 && npm start --prefix react-invoice-app"
scripts.dev:ecommerce: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:ecommerce --prefix node-learning" "npm run dev --prefix react-invoice-app/ecommerce"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix node-learning && npm install --prefix react-invoice-app && npm install --prefix react-invoice-app/ecommerce
